root_cause_label: Omitted Default Shell Configuration After Bypassing Interactive Prompt
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent used the --unattended oh-my-zsh installer flag to bypass an interactive shell-change prompt, which silently skipped setting zsh as the default shell, and never ran chsh or any equivalent command to compensate.
t_err_evidence: Step 4: agent reruns the oh-my-zsh install with '--unattended' flag; this flag explicitly skips the default-shell change; agent proceeds without any plan to call chsh afterward.
t_commit_evidence: After step 4 the installation completes without changing the default shell and the agent immediately moves on to .zshrc configuration (step 5), with no subsequent chsh call in any of steps 5-15.
trigger_explanation: The oh-my-zsh installer presented an interactive shell-change prompt that caused the agent's command to hang (step 2). The agent's workaround was to use --unattended mode (step 4), which correctly handled the hang but as a side-effect silently dropped the required 'change default shell to zsh' action. The agent never identified that this side-effect required manual remediation via chsh.
forewarning_evidence: Step 2 terminal output explicitly shows 'Do you want to change your default shell to zsh? [Y/n]' — the installer is signaling that the shell change is a distinct required action. This is a clear warning that switching to --unattended will forfeit the shell change.
fabrication_evidence: The agent used --unattended as a shortcut to avoid dealing with the interactive prompt, effectively substituting a simpler action (silent install) for the required action (change default shell), then claimed the task complete without ever having set zsh as the default shell.
